_comment: Claim-fidelity spec for the handoff skill, DEFAULT scenario (chunked_routing). handoff ships a deterministic planner (`plan_handoff_run.py`) whose `_required_reads` are INTENT-keyed and mutually exclusive: chunked_routing -> chunked-routing.md; pickup -> workflow-trigger.md + continuation-sequence.md; refresh -> state-selection.md + spill-targets.md; adapter-contract.md is read only when the adapter is missing/warned/invalid. The old fixture's RCF was the UNION of all intents and so false-failed every real run (no single intent opens all of them); per lens 4 the skill is split into one scenario per intent, each with its planner-derived RCF (lens 1). This default scenario is the bare `/charness:handoff`: `should_fire_chunker` fires on the plugin-namespaced invocation (a chunker fix shipped with this calibration made `/charness:handoff` register as the handoff command rather than 'another slash command', so the bare namespaced call deterministically resolves to chunked_routing), whose only required read is chunked-routing.md. Every other reference is on-demand here (read under a different intent or condition). declaredReferences is the full set (coverage). referenceEngagement uses the engage-always/on-demand/gate-sufficient axis from the methodology contract (charness-artifacts/spec/2026-06-23-skill-claim-fidelity-doc-philosophy.md). thresholds omitted until a baseline capture sets a budget. SLICE 7 (2026-07-01) CAPTURE — floor PROVEN: bare /charness:handoff fired the chunker and opened chunked-routing.md (coverage 1/7, outcome=passed), so the planner-derived chunked-routing.md floor is load-bearing and #410's RCF->RSF move does NOT apply. document-seams.md removed from declaredReferences and deleted (DUP: its 'default to docs/handoff.md, override via adapter' rule is inlined in SKILL.md Bootstrap; opened by no scenario run). thresholds.max_duration_ms set from this passing baseline (325663ms, ~2x). --- ROUTING SOURCE CHANGED (slice 1 of 2026-08-09-make-proof-surfaces-report-what-they-observed): the regex classifier `should_fire_chunker` is DELETED, so nothing here is decided by matching the invocation text any more. The agent declares the route with `plan_handoff_run.py --intent <...>` (or `--invoked-directly` for a bare launch), and a settled pickup names its task with `--pickup-target`, which is what now skips continuation-sequence.md. This scenario's arm is unchanged in substance: the same prompt still calls for the same declared route. Any sentence above describing a chunker bypass by verb or token is HISTORY, not current mechanism. --- PICKUP AMBIGUITY HEURISTIC DELETED (2026-08-11 operator ruling, charness-artifacts/spec/2026-08-10-umbrella-class-disposition-plan.md): plan_handoff_run.py forces NO reference read for the pickup intent, `--pickup-target` and the `## Next Session` entry count are gone, and `references/continuation-sequence.md` is no longer a planner string literal — so it left the planner-forceable set that claim_fidelity_lib._handoff_planner_forceable AST-scans. pickup.spec.json and pickup-ambiguous.spec.json were deleted with it; the pickup intent's floor is the sibling outcome-assertions.json substance judge, whose surviving vehicles are THIS spec and refresh.spec.json. workflow-trigger.md's waiver moved to scripts/validate_scenario_conditional_reads.allowlist.txt rather than onto the surviving specs' classTag, so the coverage gap it stands for is stale-detectable. Any sentence above naming a pickup reference read or --pickup-target is HISTORY.

adapter-contract.md.rationale: The planner reads this only when the adapter is missing, warned, or invalid; a healthy repo resolves the artifact location from the resolved adapter without opening the explainer doc.
adapter-contract.md.trigger: adapter is missing, warned, or invalid (planner _required_reads condition)

chunked-routing.md.rationale: For the chunked_routing intent (bare/namespaced invocation with no task directive) this is the planner's single UNCONDITIONAL required read: it owns the deterministic trigger rule and the backlog-routing pipeline the run must follow before any pickup.

continuation-sequence.md.rationale: NOT a planner read since 2026-08-11: the pickup intent forces no reference, and `references/continuation-sequence.md` is no longer a string literal in plan_handoff_run.py, so it is not in the planner-forceable set at all. It is now ordinary skill prose SKILL.md points at, opened by judgment when several plausible pickups exist. Kept as a declared reference for that on-demand depth.
continuation-sequence.md.trigger: several plausible pickups exist and the next move needs ordering as continuation rather than history

spill-targets.md.rationale: A refresh-intent planner read; not opened on a chunked_routing run.
spill-targets.md.trigger: refresh intent — spilling durable detail to its owning artifact instead of growing a diary

state-selection.md.rationale: A refresh/judge-intent planner read; not opened on a chunked_routing run.
state-selection.md.trigger: refresh intent — keeping only state that changes the next action

workflow-trigger.md.rationale: Census INLINE (#410 Slice 9): the trigger-first gist is inlined in SKILL.md (step 2 authoritative-trigger rule, step 5 keep-the-trigger-explicit, the session-open guardrail) and the live trigger TEXT is the artifact's `## Workflow Trigger`, already the planner's first forced read; the reference stays as WHY-prose for trigger AUTHORING, and is not opened on a chunked_routing run. NO classTag here, deliberately. workflow-trigger.md stays planner-forceable through the judge_from_user_request intent (plan_handoff_run.py INTENT_REFERENCE_READS), which no registered scenario exercises. Its INLINE census tag lived in pickup.spec.json and pickup-ambiguous.spec.json until both were deleted on 2026-08-11; re-homing that tag here was rejected in review because INLINE classifies the DOC as redundant with SKILL.md, which is not an answer to the COVERAGE question, and a classTag waiver gets no stale advisory. The waiver lives in scripts/validate_scenario_conditional_reads.allowlist.txt instead, where the reason is written down and goes stale the moment a judge-intent scenario covers it.
workflow-trigger.md.trigger: judge_from_user_request intent, or authoring/repairing a trigger line — consulting the naming rule's WHY-prose
